eyebrow: Machine replacement · machine at the top or at the bottom
title: Geared machine calculator
lead: Traction, ropes, motor, brake, rescue and shaft checks from the research model, with a comparison between the existing and the new machine.
exC: Example C: replacement, top, direct pull
disclaimer: The formulas follow the standards as LiftPilot’s standards register records them, each value with its document, clause and status; the ⚠ sign marks what the technician must check: estimates, the software’s choices and values still to be checked against the text. The result does not replace the signed calculation report.
dx: Deflector: horizontal offset from sheave centre
h: Deflector: vertical offset from sheave centre
Jp: Inertia per pulley (diverting; car and counterweight at 2:1)
hint_qeq: If entered, k = balancing load / Q.
hint_geo: “From dimensions”: direct pull 180°, or in a replacement from the drops of the existing machine (comparison on); with deflector from the offsets; bottom machine 180° with vertical branches.
hint_old: Layout, masses and service come from the installation; here only the data of the existing machine and ropes.
verdict_sub: With the data and assumptions entered: not a calculation report. The ⚠ sign marks what must be checked.
d_pst_torque: at the static torque: the machine runs faster than rated ({v} m/s), the motor works below its base frequency
d_mp_brake: Output torque at emergency braking (real brake)
d_mp_note: Maximum gearbox output torque: the largest of acceleration, emergency braking with every brake set (the difference of the pulls on the sheave and the sheave’s inertia) and the test with 1.25·Q; the maker is asked for this, rounded up to 10 N·m.
s_need: Above {fmax} N the electrical emergency operation is required (UNI EN 81-20:2020, 5.12.1.6), at most {v} m/s.
s_pull_dyn: Pull on the anchors with the dynamic factor × {f}
s_uplift_note: The resultant pulls the machine upwards: anchor bolts, anchors and bedplate take the larger of the net uplift at the 1.25·Q test and the pull with the rated load times the dynamic factor of the loads on the building (UNI EN 81-20:2020, 5.2.1.8.1 and E.1), both less the machine’s mass alone, which is not multiplied; to be checked by the structural engineer.
l_none: No groove change is enough within the limits.
l_note: Every fix also changes other checks (shaft load, S_f, wear): recalculate with the chosen value.
v_rescue: Emergency operation: the software checks the {fmax} N for raising the car with the rated load and, with the machine to UNI EN 81-20, the {f} N for bringing it to a landing (5.9.2.3); the means installed is checked on site.
v_eta: Gear efficiency per ratio and hoistway efficiency: from the manufacturer’s data and the actual layout.
v_inertia: Inertias J_m (motor, brake and flywheel), J_s (traction sheave), J_p (diverting pulleys) and the machine mass: from the manufacturer’s data; the brake, the decelerations and the traction at the real deceleration depend on them.
a_brake: Brake with mechanical elements in at least two sets; with one failed it must stop the loaded car going down and the empty car going up (UNI EN 81-20, 5.9.2.2.2.1).
a_dd: Traction sheave, pulley and drum diameter at least 40 times the rope diameter (14.3).
a_machine: New machine to UNI EN 81-20 (5.9.1 and 5.9.2) or UNI EN 81-1:2010 (clause 12), with the traction and rope safety factor checks (14.1).
a_overspeed: Machine stopped by an electrical safety device before the car moving up reaches the governor tripping speed (14.4 b)).
a_acop_ucm: Existing protections against ascending overspeed (ACOP) and unintended car movement (UCM): they must keep working (14.4 c) and d)).
a_stop: Stopping device at the machinery, unless a main switch or another stopping device can be reached within 1 m (UNI EN 81-20, 5.12.1.11.1 e); 14.4 e)).
a_pulleys: Guards of the pulleys in the machine room to UNI EN 81-20, 5.5.7 (14.4 f)).
a_power: Without UCM protection to 5.6.7 and with speed regulation: the brake opens only with a permanent electric current; if the two mechanical elements of the brake do not open, a device cuts the machine’s supply by the arrival at the destination floor (checked at least travelling down with an empty car) and service resumes only after a manual reset by a competent person (14.4 g)).
a_src: Source: UNI 10411-1:2024, clauses 4, 14, 17.1, 25.5 and annex C, read on the text of the standard.
c_adapt_en81: Adaptations: tested as a new installation
a_en81: Tested to UNI EN 81-20:2020 and UNI EN 81-50:2020, the installation must have the protections of a new one, among them those against ascending overspeed and unintended car movement (UNI EN 81-20, 5.6.6 and 5.6.7): the stopping element acts on the car, the counterweight, the ropes, the traction sheave or its shaft (5.6.6.4 and 5.6.7.4), so if the brake acts on the motor shaft separate certified devices are needed.
a_11: UNI 10411-11:2024, clause 14: a new machine like the original one, otherwise to UNI EN 81-20 (5.9.1 and 5.9.2) with the traction and rope checks of the original standard or of UNI EN 81-20 and the assessment of clause 4.3 (14.1); existing UCM protections must keep working (14.3 a)); without UCM to 5.6.7 and with controlled slowdown, power cut-off if the brake fails to open (14.3 b)); new ropes and their terminations like the original ones, otherwise checked on the lift with the assessment of clause 4.3 (17). If the ACOP or the stopping element of the UCM acted on the traction sheave or its shaft of the machine replaced, the new machine needs an equivalent type-examined device: a brake on the motor shaft is not an admissible stopping element (UNI EN 81-20, 5.6.6.4 and 5.6.7.4; UNI EN 81-1, 9.10.4).
a_other: The machine stays the existing one. The adaptations {norma} asks for the parts replaced or changed are to be checked on the text of the standard.
n_new: New installation: the stopping element of the protections against ascending overspeed and unintended movement acts on the car, the counterweight, the ropes, the traction sheave or its shaft (UNI EN 81-20, 5.6.6.4 and 5.6.7.4): if the brake acts on the motor shaft a separate certified device is needed.
copyfail: Copying is not allowed here: the text is selected, copy it by hand.
loaded: Loaded: {name} (illustrative data from the research, chapter 7).
invalid: Invalid fields (in red): the calculation uses a default value.
v_neq_vn: Undercut V-groove: table 2 of UNI EN 81-50:2020 gives N_equiv(t) of wedge grooves by γ; the software takes the larger of the values by γ and by β (a prudent choice): {val}.
v_geom: Groove angles: from the manufacturer’s data, or measured on a sheave that stays (wear changes them); UNI EN 81-50:2020 (5.11.2.3.1) limits: β ≤ {b}°, γ ≥ {g}° on V-grooves and γ ≥ {gu}° advised on semicircular ones; β ≤ {br}° is Montanari’s recommendation.
lg_short: This calculator is an automatic calculation aid: it makes preliminary sizing easier and faster, but its results are indicative drafts that become a calculation report, a design or a technical opinion only when a qualified technician checks and signs them. Responsibility for the design, checking the results, choosing the components and the conformity of the installation always remains with the installer and the technicians who use them.
lg_1: The software applies the formulas and values of the standards register, each with its clause and status (⚠: estimates, the software’s choices and values still to be checked), to the data entered by the user, without checking that data: wrong data produce wrong results.
lg_2: Before any use, the results must be checked by a qualified technician against the current standards (including UNI EN 81-20, UNI EN 81-50 and UNI 10411-1) and the manufacturers' data.
lg_3: Conformity of the installation, the documentation for the notified body and every decision on the installation remain the responsibility of the installer and the appointed technicians under the applicable law (including Directive 2014/33/EU and Italian DPR 162/1999).
lg_4: The software is provided with professional diligence, without warranty that it is error-free or fit for a particular purpose.

For any other use, to the extent permitted by law, Carbon Stealth VCC is not liable for damage arising from the use of the results without the check of a qualified technician; this does not affect wilful misconduct, gross negligence, personal injury and the other cases in which the law does not allow liability to be excluded or limited.

c_prop: Machine characteristics proposed by the software
p_use: Use the proposal in the check
p_alt: Alternatives: for each rope diameter, the fewest ropes and the smallest sheave
p_none: No configuration passes every check with these data. Try a larger wrap angle, a hardened V-groove, 2:1 roping or a lower acceleration.
p_crit: Criteria: 8×19 Seale fibre-core ropes, 1570 N/mm², estimated (8 mm: 30.4 kN and 0.215 kg/m, then proportional to d²) ⚠; sheaves in 40 mm steps from 320 to 800 mm, not a catalogue; rope diameter limited by the deflector pulleys too (Dp/d ≥ 40); IEC motors with acceleration torque ≤ 2 × rated; two-set brake set to the required minimum. Groove: traction utilisation ≤ 0.97 where possible, also at the real deceleration of both brake sets when the groove limits allow it. Poles, speed, frequency, efficiencies η_d and η_i, inertias Jm and Js, groove type and γ come from the “New machine” group. Proposal: first the configurations that also hold traction at the real deceleration and without reduced margins, then the fewest ropes from 4 up, then the smallest sheave.
p_speed: {v} m/s at {fn} Hz; {f} Hz for the rated speed
p_brake_sets: 2 sets of {x} N·m (required minimum {lo} N·m per set; for traction at the real deceleration: {hi})
p_manual: manual: {f} N at the handwheel ({fmax} N limit)
p_electric: electrical operation required: {f} N at the handwheel, above {fmax} N
p_upwards: upward pull: anchors for the net uplift
p_applied: Proposal loaded into the “New machine” group: the checks below are its checks.
p_util: traction {u} (at the real brake deceleration {ur}) · S_f {sa} (required {sr})
p_drop: the direct pull’s rope drop in the plan
keepD: Keep the existing sheave diameter in the proposal
keepRopes: Same number and diameter as the existing ropes
hint_keepRopes: As done in a replacement: number and diameter from the existing ropes ({n} × Ø{d}), in the proposal too. Here the breaking load and mass of the new ropes.
hint_keepRopes_free: As done in a replacement: the proposal keeps the number and diameter entered here, those of the ropes in place.
p_alt_keep: Alternatives with the same ropes: one row per sheave diameter
p_none_keep: With {n} ropes Ø{d}, as the existing ones, no configuration passes every check. To see proposals with other ropes, untick “Same number and diameter as the existing ropes”.
p_kept: number and diameter of the existing ropes
p_crit_keep: Criteria: ropes with the number and diameter of the existing ones, breaking load and mass from the “New ropes” group; sheaves in 40 mm steps from 320 to 800 mm, not a catalogue; IEC motors with acceleration torque ≤ 2 × rated; two-set brake set to the required minimum. Groove: traction utilisation ≤ 0.97 where possible, also at the real deceleration of both brake sets when the groove limits allow it. Poles, speed, frequency, efficiencies η_d and η_i, inertias Jm and Js, groove type and γ come from the “New machine” group. Proposal: first the configurations that also hold traction at the real deceleration and without reduced margins, then the smallest sheave.

v_r2: 2:1 roping: the calculation counts one car and one counterweight pulley as simple bends (other pulleys: “extra bends”) and, in the rope forces, with the inertia J_p of the diverting pulleys (UNI EN 81-50:2020, 5.11.3, term III): with different pulleys enter the equivalent inertia.
g_bend_note: With the deflector inwards the rope wraps it from the opposite side: the calculation counts it as a reverse bend.
verdict_invalid: Invalid data: fix the fields in red
dropAlign: New sheave vs existing rope drops
dr_note: Without a deflector the drop spacing equals the sheave diameter: with a different diameter the hitches stay where they are and the ropes incline. Check that they do not touch the holes in the machine-room floor or the hitches; with large shifts consider a deflector pulley.
sum_head: INDICATIVE PRELIMINARY SIZING — NOT A CALCULATION REPORT
hint_etaI: Blank: estimated as 2 − 1/η_d (worm gear). Used for the real braking deceleration.
tr_real: Braking with the real brake torque (all sets)
b_win: Torque per set: required minimum · maximum for real traction
n_trac: Emergency braking: the standard’s check uses {a} m/s² in every case (loaded and empty car, down and up, bottom and top) and gives the result; the “real brake torque” row uses the deceleration the brake gives with all sets, with η_i {e}, and is a warning.
n_real: With the real brake torque the ropes may slip in an emergency stop: keep the torque towards the required minimum or increase traction (groove, wrap angle).
v_real: Traction at the real brake deceleration: UNI EN 81-50:2020 (5.11.2.2.2) requires every moving mass with its own acceleration and a design deceleration never below the minimum, but does not say with how many brake sets; here it is a warning: whether it counts as a result is the engineer’s decision.
v_ae: Reduced-stroke buffers: the braking check uses {a} m/s². UNI EN 81-50:2020 (5.11.2.2.2) asks for the minimum deceleration that brings car and counterweight down to the buffers’ design speed: the engineer derives it from their data (0.8 m/s² is the value of UNI EN 81-1:2008, M.2.1.2).
v_etaI: η_i estimated from η_d ({x}): for the real braking deceleration enter the manufacturer’s reverse efficiency.
p_real_no: traction not ensured at the real brake deceleration ⚠
d_case_q: loaded car up from the bottom
d_case_e: empty car down from the top
sens_stable: Sensitivity: the result does not change with the car mass ±10% and the balance ±0.05.
sens_changes: Sensitivity: the result changes with {list}. Measure the car mass and the balance before deciding.
sens_note: With a measured balancing load the balance does not vary: the counterweight changes with the car mass.
sens_stable_q: Sensitivity: the result does not change with the car mass ±10% (balance measured).
sens_changes_q: Sensitivity: the result changes with {list}. Measure the car mass before deciding.
hint_P: Complete empty car: frame, doors, operator, safety gear, accessories and the part of the travelling cable (and of the compensation, if any) carried by the car.
hint_MpCat: From the gearbox catalogue; blank: not checked.
hint_shaftMax: From the maker’s data sheet; blank: not checked (the calculation gives the load in the test to ask for).
step2: Existing and new machine (or the proposal)
step3: Result at a glance and PDF
simple_note: Simple mode: the less common data (rope beyond travel, inertias, hoistway and reverse efficiencies, poles, frequency, extra bends, service) keep the loaded or typical values. Switch to “Expert” to see and change them.
q_title: New machine: result at a glance
q_more: Technical details: tables and intermediate values
q_norm: The ⚠ sign marks estimates, the software’s choices and values still to be checked against the standards: the list is in the technical details.
q_trac_ok: The ropes hold in every case of the standard (utilisation {u}).
q_trac_warn: The ropes hold, with little margin (utilisation {u}).
q_trac_beta: With this groove an undercut β of at least {b}° is needed.
q_trac_gamma: With the V-groove γ must be at most {g}°.
q_trac_real: With the real brake an emergency stop decelerates at {a} m/s² and the ropes may slip.
q_ropes_ok: S_f {sa} (required {sr}); D/d, number and diameter of the ropes compliant.
q_geom_gamma: Semicircular groove angle γ below {g}°: the standard advises against going lower.
q_motor_acc: Acceleration torque above 2 × rated: check motor and inverter.
q_brake_ok: Set each brake set to at least {lo} N·m.
q_brake_hi: For traction with the real brake, not above {hi} N·m.
q_brake_nohi: No setting keeps traction with the real brake ⚠.
q_shaft: Shaft load {kg} kg in the test with 1.25·Q.
q_shaft_nomax: To be compared with the catalogue.
q_uplift: Anchorage: net uplift of {u} kg to be checked.
q_rescue_ok: Manual rescue possible: {f} N at the handwheel ({fmax} N limit).
q_rescue_el: Electrical emergency operation needed: {f} N at the handwheel, over {fmax} N (at most {v} m/s).
est_rope: Estimate F_min and mass from the diameter ⚠
est_rope_done: Values estimated for 8×19 Seale 1570 N/mm² ropes: use the certificate values.
hint_bends: The deflector, the pulleys at the top and the 2:1 car and counterweight pulleys are already counted: here only extra pulleys.
hint_new: The machine offered by the manufacturer. Or press “Use the proposal in the check”: the characteristics proposed by the software go here.

tr_msr1: Braking with the machine–top rope at r·a
g_retain_lim: intermediate retainer with more than {below}° under the axis and more than {wrap}° of wrap
n_stall_device: Car or counterweight stalled: check replaced by an electric safety device (UNI EN 81-20:2020, 5.5.3 c) 2)), to be documented.
n_msr1: Machine below, 2:1 roping: the check follows UNI EN 81-50:2020 (5.11.3), which gives the rope between the machine and the pulleys at the top the car’s acceleration a; the “r·a” row uses that rope’s physical acceleration and is a warning.
r_two_note: With 2 ropes an electric safety device must stop the machine if one rope stretches abnormally relative to the other (UNI EN 81-20:2020, 5.5.5.3 a)).
g_retain_note: Machine below: the ropes wrap the sheave from underneath over more than {w}°; besides the retainers where the ropes enter and leave, at least one intermediate retainer is needed (UNI EN 81-20:2020, 5.5.7.2).
g_press_note: Specific pressure in the grooves to UNI 10411-1:2024, D.2: static pull on the car side at the sheave {t} N with the car at the lowest floor with its rated load, limit (12.5 + 4·v_c)/(1 + v_c) with v_c = {vc} m/s. A value for the inspection body: binding only where the minimum safety factors 12 and 16 replace the calculation of UNI EN 81-50 (14.1 c)–d)).
rope_est: 8×19 Seale, fibre core, 1570 N/mm², EN 12385-5 (family of the calculation, to be confirmed by the rope supplier’s data sheet)
rope_std: EN 12385-5: construction and strength grade to be stated (rope supplier’s data sheet)
v_comp_note: Above {g} m/s untensioned compensating means must be guided near the loop; above {r} m/s compensating ropes with a tensioning pulley are needed, outside the software’s model (UNI EN 81-20:2020, 5.5.6.1).
s_need_old: Above {fmax} N the electrical emergency operation is required (UNI EN 81-1, 14.2.1.4), at most {v} m/s.
s_fa_note: Force to bring the car to a landing with a load between (q − {b})·Q and (q + {b})·Q, in the worse direction and position (UNI EN 81-20:2020, 5.9.2.3.1 a)).
s_fa_need: Above {fmech} N the mechanical means is not allowed: the electrical means is required (5.9.2.3.1 b)), with a supply independent of the mains that brings the car with any load to the nearest landing within {h} h, at most {v} m/s, plus the electrical emergency operation (5.12.1.6).
s_gravity_note: Irreversible gear (η_i = 0): opening the brake does not move the car by gravity, the means of 5.9.2.3 are required (UNI EN 81-20:2020, 5.9.2.2.2.9).
q_rescue_ok20: Manual rescue possible: {f} N at the handwheel to raise the car with the rated load ({fmax} N limit), {fa} N to bring it to a landing ({fmech} N limit).
q_rescue_mech: Mechanical means not allowed: {fa} N to bring the car to a landing, over {fmech} N. The electrical means with an independent supply is required (5.9.2.3.1 b)).
q_gravity: Irreversible gear: the car does not move by gravity when the brake is opened.
q_stall_device: Car or counterweight stalled: check replaced by a device, to be documented.
q_msr1: With the machine–top rope at r·a the utilisation is {u}.
q_two: With 2 ropes the device against abnormal stretching is required.
q_retain: Ropes to be retained in the grooves also along the wrap.
p_manual20: manual: {f} N to raise with the rated load ({fmax} N limit), {fa} N to a landing ({fmech} N limit)
p_mech: electrical means required: {fa} N to a landing, above {fmech} N
hint_ae: From the buffers’ data: the minimum that brings car and counterweight down to their design speed (UNI EN 81-50:2020, 5.11.2.2.2), not below 0.5 m/s². Blank: 0.8 m/s².
std_1: UNI EN 81-1 (UNI 10411-1, 14.1 b), or the original standard)
hint_machineStd: With UNI EN 81-20 the 150 N of the mechanical means and the device against stalling count too; with UNI EN 81-1 only the 400 N and the stalled check.
stallDevice: Electric safety device against stalling (5.5.3 c) 2))
hint_stallDevice: Stops the machine when the car or the counterweight is stalled: a stalled check not passed becomes “Warning”, to be documented. Only with the machine to UNI EN 81-20.
hint_Dp: With pulleys of different diameters enter the smallest: it counts for D/d and, on the safe side, for N_equiv.
a_assess: Safety assessment of the modification on three levels: the component changed, those the change affects and the lift as a whole (clause 4).
a_ropes: With new ropes (UNI EN 81-20, 5.5.1) the end terminations on car, counterweight and fixed points are always checked too: to 5.5.2.3.1 or, when already of the same type, cast sockets (UNI EN 13411-4) or U-bolt grips (UNI EN 13411-5) (17.1).
a_docs: Documents of the replacement (annex C, 14): data of the new machine, setting of the frequency converter for the declared speed, traction and rope safety factor calculations (and the specific pressure, where relevant), compatibility with the existing ACOP and UCM, type examination and declaration of conformity of new ACOP or UCM; where relevant, the documents of points 5 (the building’s structure: its adequacy is shown by the owner, with the new loads), 9 (dimensioned drawing of the machine room with accesses and maintenance spaces), 10 (electrical lines redone or extended) and 15 (rated speed changed); the manuals of the machine and of the new components (25.5).
